messages:
kevin: Heads-up — hosted-integ pipeline is red on the 'hosted-end2end' job. Failing tests touch auth/session renewal + streaming/toolcall payload validation. Seen in 3 consecutive CI runs.

kevin: Example failure snippet: 
```
E   AssertionError: expected status 401 but got 200
E   at tests/integration/test_toolcall_schema.py:84
E   Trace: request id=abc123 host=hosted-api-prod-sim
```

marta: Thanks — tagging oncall. @anita @noah any recent changes to auth middleware or streaming chunking?

anita: I deployed a small change to streaming backpressure last night but it was only on a feature branch, not main. No auth changes from me.

noah: I pushed a typed schema change for toolcall args in #4521 earlier today — that touched the JSON schema validator. Could be related if validators are too strict.

sre-bot: buildkite/job/hosted-end2end #724 failed — https://buildkite.example/hosted-end2end/724 (logs uploaded) :rotating_light:

kevin: Repro steps I ran locally: 
1) Checkout commit range main~50..main
2) run `pytest tests/integration/test_toolcall_schema.py::test_toolcall_auth_and_stream --maxfail=1 -q`
Reproduces ~40% of runs locally.

marta: Can someone trigger a rerun with increased logging for auth and schema validators? `BUILDKITE_ENV=debug` or equivalent. I'll add a temporary capture for headers.

anita: I'll queue a debug rerun now and add header dumps. If it reproduces we can bisect. @noah can you point to the exact commit where the schema change landed?

noah: Schema change merged at commit f2d8b3a (PR #4521). Last green for hosted-end2end was at build 717 (main at commit e9c4a1d). So suspect range e9c4a1d..f2d8b3a.

kevin: Perfect — thanks. Marta, if rerun shows same 401->200 mismatch then bisect request: narrow to that range. If it's flaky only under concurrency we may need to reduce batch size in test harness to isolate.

marta: Rerun started: buildkite/job/hosted-end2end #725 (debug). ETA ~12m.

buildkite: build started — #725 (debug) — watcher: marta

kevin: FYI I also saw a separate stacktrace showing streaming frame length decoders choking: 
```
ValueError: frame size mismatch (expected 512, got 0)
 at runtime/streaming/frame_decoder.py:112
```
Could be two issues colliding (auth race + stream frame fragmentation).

anita: If #725 reproduces, I'll run a narrowed bisect script across f2d8b3a..e9c4a1d and drop concurrency to 1 to see if auth race disappears.

marta: Build #725 failed with same assertion (401 vs 200) — logs show missing Authorization header on retry path. Attaching log excerpt. :paperclip:

kevin: Missing header on retry path sounds like a regression in request mutability or middleware ordering. @noah can you search for any change that rearranged middleware stack around that commit?

noah: Checking... found one change in f2d8b3a that reordered middleware insertion in tests/util/mock_server.py — might be test-only but could affect integration harness. Will open PR to revert test harness ordering and run quick patch.

marta: Great. Action items:
- noah: open revert PR for harness middleware ordering and run integration quick patch. (taking)
- anita: if revert doesn't fix, bisect across e9c4a1d..f2d8b3a with concurrency=1 (taking)
- kevin: will follow up with additional logs and try local bisect script (taking)

kevin: Thanks folks. Please paste PR numbers here when created and I'll add to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:

noah: PR #4534 opened to revert test harness middleware ordering — kicked off quick CI run.

marta: CI for #4534 turned green on the hosted-end2end job. Can someone confirm this matches the fix?

kevin: Verified — reran the failing test against the artifact from #4534 and it passed 10/10. Looks like harness ordering was the culprit. Closing out the bisect.

marta: Awesome. I'll mark the pipeline as unblocked and copy notes to the postmortem doc.

sre-bot: Incident closed — hosted-end2end: intermittent auth header drop due to test harness middleware ordering. Remediation: reverted commit f2d8b3a via PR #4534.
